name: tariffmonitor-mcp
description: Tariff Exposure Monitor — live US import tariff calculator MCP server. Looks up any HTS code, returns an estimated stacked rate (MFN + Section 301, including the 2026 forced-labor tariff on 60 economies, + Section 232) and states when the Section 301 China exclusions end (11:59 p.m. EDT, 9 Nov 2026). 19,856 HTS codes. Free, no signup.
author: Dale Weaver
